about_the_game:
A girl. A city of birds and robots. A mysterious new magic.
SEALAND is a story-rich puzzle adventure set in a solar-powered ocean city built by birds and robots.

Tired of bleak future scenarios where the world has already ended?

Then welcome to SEALAND, the opposite of apocalypse!

In the year 2124, humanity may have thoroughly ruined the planet (let’s stay realistic), but don’t worry: robots and highly intelligent crows, ravens, and magpies have taken over and built a shimmering utopia in the middle of the ocean – SEALAND, a floating city using cutting-edge technology to try and save the world.

But a lab accident throws everything off balance: a strange, uncontrollable substance has been created * magic *.
To the rational minds of robots and birds, it’s a complete mystery. Their solution? Anja – a ten-year-old girl. You.

As Anja, you’ll explore this atmospheric puzzle adventure, solve tricky challenges, and try to protect the city from a massive tidal wave – or not. No pressure.
SEALAND’s not sinking. Yet.

Oh, you're still here? Good. Because SEALAND has a lot to offer:

What awaits you in SEALAND:

  • Captivating Narrative – Uncover the mysteries of a futuristic city in a story of hope and transformation.

  • Witty Companion – A sharp-tongued albino magpie guides and entertains you throughout your journey.

  • Challenging Puzzles – Solve clever, world-integrated puzzles using logic, movement, and environmental cues.

  • Atmospheric World – Dive into a stunning solar-punk city with unique design, ambient sound, and oceanic flair.

  • Eco-Futuristic Themes – Explore a vision of coexistence between nature, machines, and forgotten magic.

🌊 Add SEALAND to your wishlist – and be the first to uncover its secrets.
